title: Decompositions of a closed subset meeting point closures connectedly lift to the spectral space
statement: Let $X$ be a spectral space [def-weil-spectral-space] and $Z\subseteq X$ a closed subset such that for every $x\in X$ the set $Z\cap\overline{\{x\}}$ is connected [def-weil-connected-scheme] (in particular nonempty). If $Z=Z_1\amalg Z_2$ with $Z_1,Z_2$ closed in $Z$ (and disjoint), then there is a decomposition $X=X_1\amalg X_2$ with $X_1,X_2$ closed in $X$ (and disjoint) such that $Z_i=Z\cap X_i$ for $i=1,2$.
